pooled.denominator: pooled out-of-fold windows (labels over ALL known sites, +/-10 bp pad)

per_fold.denominator: scored windows per fold (windows overlapping train-fold sites excluded)

explanation: Average precision is a prevalence-scaled ranking summary. In the pooled OOF arrays every window of the universe is a candidate (prevalence 0.00616 for CodY). Per fold, windows overlapping TRAIN-fold sites are excluded from scoring: those windows carry ~80% of all positive labels (positives cluster at documented sites) while negatives are barely affected, collapsing per-fold prevalence ~5.3-fold (to ~0.00116). The AP values scale with their denominators' prevalence, which is why per-fold AP (~0.0039) is ~4.6x smaller than pooled AP (~0.0179). Both are correct; they answer different counting questions.
